Palm API Guide File List

Here is a list of all files with brief descriptions:

hx.h [code]This file contains the common system include files
hxalert.h [code]This file contains definitions for the Hx UI Toolkit alert API
hxalerts.h [code]This file contains definitions for the Hx alert sounds API
hxapplication.h [code]This file contains definitions for the Hx Toolkit file API
hxapplicationbar.h [code]This file contains definitions for the Hx UI Toolkit Application Bar API. The application bar is a window placed above the application window that contains the application name and optional widgets
hxappmgr.h [code]
hxarray.h [code]This file contains definitions for the Hx Toolkit dynamic array implementation
HxBtDebug.h [code]Bluetooth debugging header
HxBtLib.h [code]
HxBtMsg.h [code]Bluetooth Messaging structures
HxBtTypes.h [code]OS / Hardware independent data type definitions. Module: Bluetooth kernel/user data types
hxcertui.h [code]
hxcheckbox.h [code]This file contains definitions for the Hx UI Toolkit checkbox control API
hxclipboard.h [code]This file contains definitions for the Hx UI Toolkit clipboard handling
hxcolordialog.h [code]This file contains definitions for the Hx UI Toolkit color picker dialog API
hxcolumnheader.h [code]This file contains definitions for the Hx UI Toolkit column header API. The column header widget is used by the File Manager application and by the file dialogs, and allows the application to define buttons at the top of multi-column extended lists
hxcombobox.h [code]This file contains definitions for the Hx UI Toolkit combo box widget API
hxcommandbutton.h [code]This file contains definitions for the Hx UI Toolkit command button control API. Command buttons are typically used in modal dialogs (for example, the "OK" and "Cancel" widgets)
hxcontainer.h [code]This file contains definitions for the Hx UI Toolkit container API. Containers are used to group a set of child widgets
hxcursor.h [code]This file contains definitions for the Hx UI Toolkit cursor handling
hxdatabase.h [code]This file contains definitions for the Hx Toolkit database API
hxdatetime.h [code]This file contains functions to support retrieving locale specific strftime formatting strings with some control over simple formatting requirements for the locale
hxdebug.h [code]This file contains definitions for the Hx Toolkit debugging API
hxdialog.h [code]This file contains definitions for the Hx UI Toolkit dialog API
hxdropdownbox.h [code]This file contains definitions for the Hx UI Toolkit dropdown box widget API
hxfield.h [code]This file contains definitions for the Hx UI Toolkit text field management API
hxfile.h [code]This file contains definitions for the Hx Toolkit file API
hxfiledialog.h [code]This file contains definitions for the Hx UI Toolkit file dialog API. It includes support for the Open File, Save File, Save As File, and New File dialogs
hxfilelist.h [code]This file contains definitions for the Hx UI Toolkit filelist API. The filelist widget is used by the File dialogs and File Manager application. It is an extended list that displays the contents of a directory
hxfont.h [code]This file contains definitions for the Hx UI Toolkit font loading and string measurement API
hxgadget.h [code]This file contains definitions for the Hx UI Toolkit gadget control API. A gadget is a selectable button that can be displayed with an image and/or text. One common use of a gadget is for icons placed in the application bar or in a toolbar
hxgraphics.h [code]This file contains definitions for the Hx UI Toolkit drawing API
hxhtmlview.h [code]This file contains definitions for the Hx HTML Viewer widget
hximage.h [code]This file contains definitions for the Hx UI Toolkit graphics image API
hxkeyboard.h [code]This file contains definitions for the Hx UI Toolkit keyboard constants
hxlabel.h [code]This file contains definitions for the Hx UI Toolkit label API
hxlist.h [code]This file contains definitions for the Hx UI Toolkit List API. This API is used by both dropdown box and list box widgets
hxlistbox.h [code]This file contains definitions for the Hx UI Toolkit listbox widget API. A listbox is a widget containing a list of strings
hxlistextended.h [code]This file contains definitions for the Hx UI Toolkit extended list API
hxmenu.h [code]This file contains definitions for the Hx UI Toolkit menu API
hxmessage.h [code]This file contains definitions for the Hx Toolkit message passing API
hxmessagedomain.h [code]This file contains definitions for the Hx message passing API
hxmime.h [code]Mime is defined here
hxnetui.h [code]This file contains definitions for the Hx Toolkit file API
hxpinwheel.h [code]This file contains definitions for the Hx UI Toolkit PinWheel API
hxpower.h [code]This file contains definitions for the Hx Power high level API's
hxprogressbar.h [code]This file contains definitions for the Hx UI Toolkit Progress Bar API
hxproperty.h [code]This file contains definitions for the Hx Toolkit Property system
hxpropertydomain.h [code]This file contains definitions of the Hx Toolkit Property domains
hxradiobutton.h [code]This file contains definitions for the Hx UI Toolkit radio button control API
hxregion.h [code]This file contains definitions for the Hx UI Toolkit region API
hxresfile.h [code]This file contains definitions for the Hx UI Toolkit resource file API
hxscrollbar.h [code]This file contains definitions for the Hx UI Toolkit scrollbar API
hxseparator.h [code]This file contains definitions for the Hx UI Toolkit Separator widget API. The separator is a standard graphic primitive placed within the toolkit heirarchy, and provides a visual mechanism to group widgets
hxslider.h [code]This file contains definitions for the Hx UI Toolkit slider control API
hxsoftkeyboard.h [code]This file contains definitions for the Hx UI Toolkit soft keyboard API
hxsound.h [code]This file contains definitions for the Hx Toolkit high level audio APIs
hxspinbutton.h [code]This file contains definitions for the Hx UI Toolkit spin button control API
hxstorage.h [code]This file contains definitions for the Hx Toolkit storage API
hxstoragelist.h [code]This file contains definitions for the Hx UI Toolkit storage list API. A storage list is an extended list implementation, containing list items representing the internal store, as well as SD card and USB drive volumes. This widget is used by the File dialogs as well as the File Manager application
hxtabs.h [code]This file contains definitions for the Hx UI Toolkit Tabs API
hxtypes.h [code]This file contains basic definitions for the Hx Toolkit
hxui.h [code]This file lists the HxUI Toolkit public include files
hxuiinit.h [code]This file contains definitions for the initializing and releasing the Hx UI Toolkit and for controlling application behavior
hxuitypes.h [code]This file contains definitions for the basic Hx UI Toolkit data structures
hxwidget.h [code]This file contains definitions for the Hx UI Toolkit widget API
hxwindow.h [code]This file contains definitions for the Hx UI Toolkit window API
